sector.narrative: Adolescent health and wellbeing (including sexual and reproductive health)
Basic drinking water supply and basic sanitation
Breastfeeding protection, promotion and support, including work on the code of marketing o breastmilk substitutes
Digital Health and Health Information Systems
Environmental Pollution and Health (including air pollution, lead, pesticides and others)
Existence of national costed ECD action plans and family friendly policies
Facility based maternal and newborn care (including emergency obstetric and newborn care, quality improvement)
Health systems procurement and supplies management
IMNCI facilities and referral level management of childhood illnesses (e.g., ETAT, inpatient care)
Immunization Demand and Social and Behavior Change
Immunization service delivery to reach zero dose children
Provide maternal, newborn, and child health at the primary and secondary health care facilities
UNICEF-supported parenting programmes for parents and caregivers
